tasks.acceptance_prose: Conventions: see lw-0-scaffold. TASK: LearningWorldsApp.cs - Boot only when scene name starts with LearningWorlds-; EnsureRig() creates DontDestroyOnLoad LW-Rig camera WASD+RMB fly editor; Go(World w, int ele=-1) unload old LearningWorlds scene via SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync await then create new scene LearningWorlds-World scene set active call Builders[w](); persistent rig survives; LabSceneName: scan Assets/Scenes/*.unity find one with Menu/Aoi name fallback '00_Menu' static field; OpenLab() calls SceneManager.LoadScene(LabSceneName). Portal.cs: OnTriggerEnter use cooldown calls LearningWorldsApp.Go(targetWorld). Editor/LearningWorldsMenus.cs namespace LearningWorlds.Editor [MenuItem LearningWorlds/Open Hub Scene] static void OpenHub() { if Application.isPlaying return; EditorSceneManager.NewScene(DefaultGameObjects Single) then open Assets/Scenes/LearningWorlds-Hub.unity } [MenuItem LearningWorlds/Register Build Scenes] static void Register() { add LearningWorlds-Hub scene to EditorBuildSettings.scenes }.

tasks.title: Compile fix: run Unity batchmode compile gate, fix all compile errors under LearningWorlds
tasks.acceptance_prose: TASK: Run the compile gate and fix any C# errors under Assets/LearningWorlds/. In this worktree (Unity project root): bash ci/unity-compile.sh. On exit 1 (compile errors): open Temp/unity-compile.log grep error CS fix ONLY LearningWorlds code missing usings/semicolons/UnityEngine refs; iterate until exit 0. On exit 42 (env/license failure): inspect Temp/unity-compile.log tail if remediable config change apply and retry once; if environmental declare BLOCKER in commit message (fail is ok). Note: first compile imports all PICO SDK Android packages ~20-60 min wait do not kill Unity. Conventions: NO .unity/.prefab/.asset. Only fix errors in LearningWorlds scripts.
